refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: OAuth2 refresh token. Run 'npx homebridge-netatmo-home-control auth' to obtain it.

home_id.title: Home ID (optional)
home_id.description: Limit to a specific Netatmo home. Leave empty to include all homes.

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often to refresh device states from the Netatmo API.

gateway_types.title: Gateway Types (optional)
gateway_types.description: Comma-separated Netatmo gateway/device types to restrict discovery to (e.g. 'NLG' for Legrand Home+Control only). Leave empty to discover all gateway families, including BTicino MyHome (MyHomeServer1).
